prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:

Regional Medical Director: clinical/delegation/surge/destination/protocol advice,including communication-limited prioritization;no dispatch authority. Jurisdictions own policy/boundaries. Computer Aided Dispatch Console: incidents/resources/access/staging/surge/constraints;latest confirmed status/time/source;verify currency. Ambulance Coordination Platform: priority/capability/availability/constraint matching;timestamped movements/destinations/instructions;separate accepted-mutual-aid tracking;queues interrupted updates/flags reconciliation. Dispatchers compare response-time/coverage under regional authorization;failed voice requires available approved data channel and timestamped attempts;restoration requires timestamp reconciliation/preserved discrepancies. Shift Commander(Sundial): receives capacity alerts/Coverage Gap Bulletin;decides staffing/deployment;approves coverage-reducing/nonstandard exceptions;sends Mutual Aid Release Form;coordinates surge;confirms post-surge handover;cannot override clinical/crew authority;retains authority until named-successor acknowledgment/higher-command takeover. Outgoing shift records incidents/failures/channel assignments/pending decisions;incoming verifies assignments/available paths before acceptance.
